executor: Authorized external host (Claude Code cloud session) during explicit REPOSITORY_MAINTENANCE; no repository-owned scanner, CI, script or runtime used or added.
scanner_install: pip install git+https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillSpector.git@c7958a3268d9498644b22edb75d0f051bbc8cbfc into an isolated host virtualenv; reported version 2.12.0, package_vcs_metadata revision matches pin.
invocation: skillspector scan <exported exact git tree> --no-llm --fail-on-findings --fail-on-incomplete --format json
package_export: git archive <commit>:<package path> into an empty per-tree directory; package_git_tree_sha is git rev-parse <commit>:<path>.
egress: No LLM provider configured or requested (metadata.llm_requested=false). No package content sent to third-party models. Raw reports kept only in ephemeral host scratch; report_sha256 digests persisted.
state_rule: state equals the fail-closed scanner gate result. host_disposition values are proposals; no record is promoted to findings-reviewed without maintainer acceptance. A pass is static security evidence only, not semantic, behavioral or user-fit approval.
scope: All 51 SKILL.md packages under skills/ and engine/skills/ at current main (44 first-party user-facing + 7 engine procedures), plus the exact changed final trees of draft PRs #686 (5) and #673 (16).
baseline_reconciliation_note: Unchanged trees reproduce the 2026-10-10 baseline state exactly; the scanner is deterministic for these packages at this pin. Report digests differ because reports embed scan time and local path.
